sentence: Liver blood tests can point towards a possible problem but do not name the cause, and results that are not normal are very common.

sentence: Liver blood tests are a group of blood tests, once known as liver function tests or LFTs.
note: BLT page title: liver blood tests (formerly LFTs)

sentence: They can include ALT, AST, ALP, GGT, bilirubin and albumin.
note: blended summary of components | edited after second pass

sentence: ALT and AST are enzymes that leak into the blood when liver cells are injured.
note: blended summary: ALT/AST reflect liver cell injury; the enzyme wording is textbook

sentence: ALT is more specific to the liver, while AST can also be high when muscle is damaged elsewhere in the body.
note: LTO

sentence: Common causes of this pattern include viral hepatitis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, alcohol-related liver disease, autoimmune hepatitis and drug-induced liver injury.
note: City and Hackney pathway list

sentence: In alcohol-related liver injury AST is often higher than ALT, whereas in fatty liver disease ALT is often the higher of the two.
note: added after second pass: AST typically higher than ALT in alcohol-related fatty liver, NAFLD shows ALT higher than AST.

sentence: Muscle injury, a heart attack and an underactive thyroid can also raise ALT and AST.
note: added after second pass: Non-liver sources: polymyositis, acute muscle injury, acute myocardial infarction and hypothyroidism can raise these enzymes.

sentence: Raised ALP and GGT point towards a problem with the flow of bile.
note: pathway: predominantly raised ALP and GGT indicate cholestasis

sentence: Causes include blocked bile ducts, for example by stones, and some long-term diseases of the bile ducts.
note: pathway: biliary obstruction, PBC, PSC

sentence: ALP also comes from bone, so GGT helps to show whether the liver is the source.
note: pathway

sentence: Raised bilirubin causes jaundice, a yellowing of the eyes and skin.
note: LTO / Devon

sentence: Bilirubin can also be raised without liver disease, as in Gilbert's syndrome, where the other liver tests are normal.
note: LTO

sentence: Albumin is affected only when liver disease is at a severe stage, and other factors can also change albumin results.
note: blended summary | edited after second pass

sentence: A normal GGT alongside a raised ALP points towards a source other than the liver, such as bone.
note: added after second pass: Normal GGT raises the possibility of a nonhepatic source such as bone.

sentence: Bilirubin is a pigment made when red blood cells break down, and the liver normally clears it.
note: added after second pass: Bilirubin is a pigment from breakdown of red blood cells; liver normally clears it.

sentence: Albumin is a protein made by the liver.
note: added after second pass: Albumin is a protein the liver makes.

sentence: Abnormal results can occur in conditions that do not involve the liver, and normal results can be found in people with serious liver disease.
note: LTO

sentence: The British Liver Trust says it is very common to have some liver blood test results that are not normal.
note: BLT | edited after second pass

sentence: It also says it is possible to have a normal liver blood test result and still have a serious liver condition.

sentence: Medicines and herbal supplements can raise liver enzymes, as can some non-liver problems such as muscle injury.

sentence: Guidelines usually start by repeating the tests, and move to further checks if results stay abnormal.

sentence: Laboratories compare each result with their own range, so results are compared only with the range of the laboratory that did the test.

sentence: If the results suggest a liver problem, a GP may calculate a FIB-4 index, which gives an indication of the amount of scarring in the liver.

sentence: Depending on the results, age and possible causes, a GP may arrange more tests or regular repeat tests.

sentence: Further tests can look for the cause, such as viral hepatitis, fatty liver disease or an effect of alcohol or medicines.

sentence: Pathways differ between areas on when to repeat tests and which scores trigger referral, so the steps a GP follows can vary.

sentence: The NHS says jaundice can be a sign of something serious such as liver disease.

sentence: It advises asking for an urgent GP appointment or contacting NHS 111 when the skin or whites of the eyes look yellow.

sentence: On brown or black skin the yellow colour is easier to see in the whites of the eyes.

sentence: Itchy skin, darker urine and paler stools can come with it.

sentence: Where alcohol is the cause, one pathway advises cutting out alcohol and repeating the test after a month.
